items.title_en: It Is Going To Be Raghu And Rajiv Vs Devarshi In Epic Roadies Showdown
items.title_zh: Raghu 和 Rajiv 对阵 Devarshi 的史诗级公路赛对决
items.summary_en: Devarshi Patel, who became a sensation even before social media took over for his unforgettable audition on Roadies 6, reunites with Raghu Ram and Rajiv Lakshman.
items.summary_zh: 德瓦什·帕特尔 (Devarshi Patel) 因在《Roadies 6》中令人难忘的试镜而在社交媒体上引起轰动，他与拉古·拉姆 (Raghu Ram) 和拉吉夫·拉克什曼 (Rajiv Lakshman) 重聚。
